equivalence: labelled rows plus seeded fresh oracle points from a widened domain; probe-equivalence, not a proof

metric_definitions.equivalent_any_status: the returned rule matches the oracle on all labelled and fresh points, whatever its status
metric_definitions.exact_structure: the rule equals the reference rule up to commutative operand order
metric_definitions.false_positive: status locally_validated but the rule disagrees with the oracle on at least one fresh point; the metric a learner must keep at zero
metric_definitions.recovered: status locally_validated and the rule matches the oracle on every labelled row and every seeded fresh oracle point (exact structure or probe-equivalence over the fresh points)
metric_definitions.wrong_rule_any_status: some rule was returned (any status) and it disagrees with the oracle on a fresh point
